== Description ==

[[Randy Scott]] (left, Avalanche cap) and [[Spencer Gosiaco]] (back right, dark Mariners S cap and black jacket) at a table with an opponent in an Arizona cap (front right, unlabeled) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
